properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dev-only dependency of the examples/wasm browser demo: ganache-cli (local chain simulator) pulls the ethereumjs/elliptic JS stack, which uses hash.js for SHA-1/SHA-256 hashing. Not part of any shipped Rust crate.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: k256 = { features = ["ecdsa", "std"] } in ethers-core — secp256k1 ECDSA recoverable-signature verification and public-key→address derivation; curve fixed by the Ethereum protocol, so PQ replacement is chain-constrained, changeable here only at the dependency level.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 locked in examples/wasm/yarn.lock via ganache-cli (JS dev chain for the wasm webpack example) — secp256k1 ECDSA/ECDH capability available to dev tooling only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge@1.3.1 locked in examples/wasm/yarn.lock via selfsigned/webpack-dev-server (dev HTTPS cert for the wasm example); AES available in the shipped library, no first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: pbkdf2@3.1.2 locked in examples/wasm/yarn.lock via ganache-cli keystore/secret-storage tooling; dev tooling only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js@3.0.1 locked in examples/wasm/yarn.lock via ganache-cli (keystore KDF); dev tooling only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Key custody is in the AWS control plane — this repo only fixes the signing algorithm (ECDSA_SHA_256, mod.rs:141) and the key id; the key spec (ECC_SECG_P256K1 for Ethereum) is decided in the AWS account. Observable here, changeable only in AWS. Transport: rusoto rustls.

properties.name: pqs:context
